To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The criticism of the work of Jhingan and collaborators by Antia on dust collapse in spherical symmetry is not valid; (2) The claim by Antia that strong naked singularities are unstable is not correct.

(1) The claim by Antia that the density of a Newtonian fluid in Eulerian coordinates can have only even terms is incorrect, because Jhingan and co-authors have used Lagrangian coordinates, and not the Eulerian coordinates used by Antia.
(i) in Eulerian coordinates, the density of a Newtonian fluid can be expanded only in even powers, but (ii) in Lagrangian (or comoving) coordinates, the density can have both even and odd powers.
